Furthermore, the `positive_control()` has been successfully added to `extract_controls()` to ensure the gate cannot ship without its control, perfectly fulfilling the ticket requirements without introducing any forbidden behavior.

The diff perfectly implements the requirements of PMAT-3715 and the receipt claims. The SHACL shape enforces the required matrix of cells, and all edge cases (missing, skipped, fallback, stale receipts, kernel architecture mismatches, tokenizer parity) are verified in the test suite to turn the gate red and name the cell. There are no doctrinal violations, weakened gates, or unauthorized scopes. The gate works exactly as requested.
The audit prompt file was fully read, the repository builds, and all tests pass. No issues found.
